supporting_observations.claim: The recurring outbound activity shown in the records is to update.casebinder.com through the organization's proxy, with connections at approximately 13:39:30, 13:43:34, 13:48:59, 13:54:03, 13:59:26, 14:04:21, and 14:09:02 UTC.

The activity is consistent with the approved CaseBinder updater: the process ran from C:\Program Files\CaseBinder\casebinderupd.exe, and its network events to the proxy align in time with the updater's connections to update.casebinder.com.
The observed recurrence is roughly five minutes apart and matches the inventory description of CaseBinder checking update.casebinder.com about every five minutes.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records identify the destination and mark these connections as tunnels, while host network records show connections to the proxy on port 8080; these records do not expose the contents of the HTTPS exchanges. Relevant records include T176-00129, T176-00130, T176-00131, T176-00203, T176-00205, and T176-00206.
The supplied records show the CaseBinder-related sequence beginning at 13:39 UTC; they do not establish what generated any alerted connections between 13:30 and that time.
claims_not_established: The records do not establish the contents of the HTTPS traffic or whether any data was sent beyond the connection metadata and byte counts.
The records do not independently verify the updater executable's integrity or authenticity.
unrelated_findings: Noah Kim's browser accessed a Google Docs document, a cloud-document service not listed among the approved services. This is separate from the CaseBinder updater activity; the records do not establish whether a document was uploaded or downloaded. Records: T176-00085, T176-00086, T176-00094, T176-00095.

The domain account greta.lund authenticated from WS-NKIM-01 to FILE-MAP-01 during the review window. This is separate from the alerted outbound HTTPS activity and merits review against expected help-desk activity. Records: T176-00278, T176-00279, T176-00282.
